scope: visual structure and declared catalog metadata only; not a reproduction or scientific-method validation
review_scope: All 29 inspected across eight full-resolution contact sheets for panel order, axes, legend placement, annotations and color roles; one representative per 12 recipe families was previously opened individually. This is visual review, not caption/data/code verification or final-size reproduction QA.

corrections.ASF-V06: Six curve panels b-g (not five) are arranged 2x3 beside four locator/inset maps.
corrections.ASF-V13: Panel a is the main region-by-production-stage matrix; panel b shows stage/capacity change over time; panel c is the global production map.
corrections.ASF-V28: Twelve panels A-L form four representation rows by three matched conditions: raw points, paths/flows, probability summaries and density surfaces; not three rows.

detail_review.limits: Small text, exact statistical definitions and scientific interpretation require the original article and are not certified by contact-sheet review.

rights: source art stays external; no images or complete palettes embedded in BioFigure

entries.visible_layout: Single tall network-on-map panel; outlined regions, colored hubs and dense weighted links; category and node-size legends at right.
entries.visible_color_roles: Many colored clusters on pale map; saturated colors distinguish groups, gray links recede.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Keep equal map projection; simplify edges/labels; place size and category legends outside the geography.

entries.visible_layout: Seven matched maps in a 4+3 grid; each panel repeats scale bar, north arrow and local callouts.
entries.visible_color_roles: Pale yellow-to-orange-to-red ordered fills on a light basemap.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Fix common extent/projection and category breaks; align repeated map frames; reserve caption/legend space.

entries.visible_layout: Wide map at left and narrow dot-over-box summary at right; common category shapes/color.
entries.visible_color_roles: Cool-to-violet map gradient; category hues repeated in points and boxes.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Use sf for map and point+box plot independently; align panel height; never infer sample independence from visual.

entries.visible_layout: Two dark spatial views side by side with matched camera and one shared stepped color key.
entries.visible_color_roles: Near-black background; cyan-blue low and warm yellow-red high.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Lock extent, view and scale for comparison; add sufficient contrast and colorbar ticks.

entries.visible_layout: Left stack of line, horizontal box/dot and vertical box/dot; center dominant choropleth; right four time-series strips.
entries.visible_color_roles: Blue and green groups consistently across map, boxes and curves; gray basemap.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Use asymmetric width ratios and shared time scales; link color semantics across panels; keep legends compact.

entries.visible_layout: Four regional locator/inset maps occupy the left block; six event-specific displacement/decay panels b-g form a 2x3 grid on the right.
entries.visible_color_roles: One hue per event, repeated in curve and corresponding map inset.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Keep inset hierarchy and shared x/y definitions; color by event, not by panel; annotate model parameters separately.

entries.visible_layout: Six lettered regions arranged 2x3; each has upper log-scaled area/time plot and lower aligned variant bubble rows.
entries.visible_color_roles: Pastel variant categories against gray background; gray Others; fill of area matches region.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Pair plots by shared date x scale; encode bubble area, not radius; reserve a common size legend.

entries.visible_layout: Three horizontal bands: prevalence small multiples, trend curves with uncertainty, then origin-destination maps by variant.
entries.visible_color_roles: Categorical variant colors persist through all bands; movement lines add direction/color.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Reserve row heights before drawing; keep 5 columns aligned; define map direction and line transparency.

entries.visible_layout: Two rows by five columns; top bar comparisons, bottom CCDF/model plots aligned by category.
entries.visible_color_roles: Pink/green top contrasts; lower data/model/null styles separated by marker and line.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Use shared x categories and row-specific y scales; preserve marker/line meaning and logarithmic lower axes.

entries.visible_layout: Maps/densities form left column, mechanism diagram/equations right, model curves below.
entries.visible_color_roles: Muted four-level categorical hues repeat across maps, density and diagram.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Build diagram as independent vector panel; synchronize level colors; validate formulas from primary article.

entries.visible_layout: Tall annotated event timeline left, choropleth map upper right, narrow time series stack lower right.
entries.visible_color_roles: Red events and curves emphasized; gray context; pink-red map ramp.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Set major panel ratio first; allocate label track for timeline; decimate annotations if crowded.

entries.visible_layout: Two-row comparison: upper sparse weekday/weekend lollipop points; lower paired 100% stacked horizontal bars with connected segment boundaries.
entries.visible_color_roles: Red and blue contrast, neutral gray middle segment.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Align categories between rows; separate value labels from segment edges; do not imply paired units unless true.

entries.visible_layout: Panel a is a wide region-by-production-stage matrix; panel b shows capacity/stage changes over time; panel c is a global production-increase map.
entries.visible_color_roles: Stage colors pale blue, red, yellow, green, violet; map uses separate sequential ramp.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Draw node/edge layers from explicit keys; use dedicated map scale; avoid using color for two meanings.

entries.visible_layout: Dominant dark world map; longitudinal distribution above, latitudinal marginal at right, signed horizontal bars below; bivariate map key.
entries.visible_color_roles: Blue and orange/red opposing changes on black with a two-axis map key; white labels.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Lock shared geographic axis between map and marginals; diverging scale centered at zero; test contrast at export size.

entries.visible_layout: Two-row maps comparing predicted and observed networks; bottom validation scatter and line plots.
entries.visible_color_roles: Black background, magenta/white flows with cyan/orange highlights.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Make light text readable; align geographic panels; keep validation axes separate from map color scale.

entries.visible_layout: Three parallel panels: point estimates, grouped bars and grouped boxplots for same two methods.
entries.visible_color_roles: Cyan and coral consistently map to methods; neutral black axes.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Keep method order and palette fixed; distinguish variability/error definition from raw distribution.

entries.visible_layout: Four-panel 2x2 grid: grouped bars on top; individual points and trends below, same two targets across columns.
entries.visible_color_roles: Pale orange, green and pink groups; sample marks darker than bars.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Use log y axis only for positive titres; draw reference threshold; brackets need headroom and verified comparisons.

entries.visible_layout: Six equal panels 2x3 with log x/y where indicated; symbols separate datasets and lines separate models.
entries.visible_color_roles: Small four-color series palette; gray theoretical guides.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Define transformation per panel, shared typography and consistent model/data legend; no zero on log axes.

entries.visible_layout: Six panels 3x2; upper errorbar trajectories, middle/lower log parameter scans with threshold lines.
entries.visible_color_roles: Blue, red and green methods held constant across panels.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Reserve top margin for equations; annotate regime boundaries; align parameter axes only where units match.

entries.visible_layout: Left histogram with fitted density and marginal boxplot; right ranked-density raster with overlaid horizontal boxplots and colorbar.
entries.visible_color_roles: Orange-red frequency/intensity scale with dark line annotations.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Do not treat heatmap counts as independent points; synchronize rank x and box positions; keep colorbar separate.

entries.visible_layout: Two equal scatter panels with size/color encoded points, dashed regression, gray interval and dotted zero reference.
entries.visible_color_roles: Cyan and amber groups; black model line, neutral confidence ribbon.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Fit from declared experimental units; label R²/P from the actual model; size mapping needs a legend and overlap control.

entries.visible_layout: Five columns by three metric rows; each cell shows colored estimates and vertical uncertainty by strategy.
entries.visible_color_roles: Navy baseline, cyan sequential and coral parallel; consistent across all 15 cells.
entries.implementation_hypothesis: Predeclare metric units and panel-specific y limits; common method x order; avoid truncation hiding uncertainty.

entries.visible_color_roles: Blue base network; green/yellow/red mark higher path classes.

entries.visible_color_roles: Pale base roads, violet-purple traffic intensity.

entries.visible_color_roles: Gray background; category-colored points/routes; multihue density at bottom.

entries.visible_layout: Two quantitative panels across top; large route/demand map below with line-width and origin/destination keys.
entries.visible_color_roles: Green/orange/violet charts; green route emphasis and blue-red map fields.
